steps.comment: The rule reads recipes rather than naming classes, so the only real check is against the loaded def database — an offline test cannot know that apparel recipes carry an unfinished thing. The step logs a full census of work-table defs and their verdicts. Absent DLC defs are skipped and reported, not failed.

args.comment_groupable: Benches with at least one shareable recipe. The last three make nothing but unfinished-item orders (census: 0 plain recipes each), so they were excluded until those orders became shareable (issue #11); they are here to prove the gate opened for them. SubcoreEncoder's only recipe, SubcoreBasic, is an unfinished-item recipe, not a forming one.
args.groupable: ElectricStove, FueledStove, TableStonecutter, ElectricSmelter, ButcherSpot, TableButcher, DrugLab, BiofuelRefinery, Brewery, Campfire, TableMachining, ElectricSmithy, FueledSmithy, ElectricTailoringBench, HandTailoringBench, TableSculpting, FabricationBench, SubcoreEncoder
args.comment_notGroupable: The negative path: benches where every recipe makes a bill that casts the list's owner back to its own bench class — mech gestation. These share the code path with the unfinished-item benches now, so this is what shows the refusal still holds.
